milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task — the player must navigate close enough to the gold block and be facing toward it to demonstrate they have visually located it. The gold block is at spawn-relative (6, 3, 4) on top of a stone brick pillar. max_distance=16 is generous (the block is only ~7 blocks from spawn), and facing_tolerance=60 degrees ensures the player is actually looking at the gold block, not just passing by. This is preferred over position_inside_box because it models 'player can see the target' rather than just 'player walked to a region'.
